curriculum.decision: Existing 100M curriculum screen did not beat full-from-start baseline; staged curriculum is not supported by current evidence.

router_repair.scope: Bounded 500K-token router-regret repair screen on broad_nlp_train with official_like_dev evaluation. Final official bounded files are not used.

shared_substrate.scope: Teacher-independent substrate screen on broad_nlp_train with official_like_dev evaluation. Final official bounded files are not used.

aggregation_definitions.domain_weighted: Equivalent to paired_macro_file in this bounded suite because each top-level official JSONL file is treated as one domain.
aggregation_definitions.paired_macro_file: Mean of per-file candidate-minus-baseline differences, each official JSONL file weighted equally.
aggregation_definitions.paired_micro: All evaluated blocks across all official JSONL files, weighted by evaluated token count.
aggregation_definitions.scorecard_lm_loss: Existing run_lm_eval scorecard lm_loss; with the current runner and --limit it evaluates the first limited windows of selected concatenated text, so it is not identical to this all-file paired audit.

aux.caveat: This is a short reduced screen for routing auxiliary weight selection pressure, not promotion-scale training.
aux.scope: Reduced 100M official-like development screen; final official files not used.

final_official_bounded.purpose: Final untouched evaluation only; not for checkpoint selection or hyperparameter search.

official_like_development.purpose: Router and substrate development; must exclude final official examples.

curriculum.promotion_rule: Lowest Frankenstein heldout LM loss with nonzero router gradients and clean strict Top1.
curriculum.selection_dataset: local Frankenstein heldout plus diagnostic code/JSON losses

evidence.claim_boundary: The curve/report values are internally consistent for Set A. Exact-resume equivalence is not supported by this checkpoint because optimizer/RNG state is absent.

report_row.checkpoint_status_caveat: PVR final checkpoint metadata is inconsistent after timeout; curve/report artifacts are used for evidence.

evidence.scope: Audits current raw 5M artifacts and report lineage only; no model training or final official-file selection.

resume.interpretation: Legacy final checkpoints are loadable for evaluation but do not contain enough optimizer/RNG state to prove exact interrupted continuation.

router_1m_confirmation.scope: Bounded 500K-token router-regret repair screen on broad_nlp_train with official_like_dev evaluation. Final official bounded files are not used.

router_1m_refinement.scope: Bounded 1M-token lower-weight router-regret refinement on broad_nlp_train with official_like_dev evaluation. The 1M no-regret baseline is reused from the completed confirmation report; final official bounded files are not used.

confirmation.scope: Bounded 500K-token router-regret repair screen on broad_nlp_train with official_like_dev evaluation. Final official bounded files are not used.

greedy_baseline.scope: Official-like development set only. Greedy blockwise full-network oracle; not exhaustive combinatorial oracle.

greedy_repair.scope: Official-like development set only. Greedy blockwise full-network oracle; not exhaustive combinatorial oracle.

reasoning.eval_gate_alignment: WEAK; training eval gate uses four single 256-token windows, while oracle audit covers seven official-like files with 64-token blocks.
reasoning.lm_eval_effect: NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_PROMOTION; regret0p01 is slightly worse on all four training eval windows.
reasoning.most_likely_diagnosis: The regret objective improves final-block expert selection on the oracle-audit distribution but over-concentrates owner utilization and does not transfer to the tiny training-eval windows. The block is therefore an evaluation-alignment plus over-regularized-routing problem, not a useless-expert problem.
reasoning.report_or_checkpoint_inconsistency: NOT_SUPPORTED; exact checkpoints, no resume events, matched steps/tokens/windows.
reasoning.router_metric_effect: SUPPORTED; regret0p01 reduces final-block regret and increases selected-is-oracle/top2 rates.
reasoning.routing_side_effect: SUPPORTED; regret0p01 lowers owner entropy and increases monopoly rate, suggesting over-concentrated routing.

mismatch.recommendation: Do not promote regret0p01. Replace the four-window LM gate with a full official-like micro/macro gate, then test lower or annealed regret weights with an entropy/monopoly retention constraint.

raw_1block.scope: Full-network LM loss on official-like development files only. Uses bounded first-block file coverage to align with the oracle/regret audit without touching final official bounded files.

raw_2block.scope: Full-network LM loss on official-like development files only. Uses bounded first-block file coverage to align with the oracle/regret audit without touching final official bounded files.

text_only.scope: Full-network LM loss on official-like development files only. Uses bounded file coverage to align with the oracle/regret audit without touching final official bounded files.

router_gap_resolution.recommendation: Stop regret0p01 as a promotion candidate. If router repair continues, use lower/annealed regret weights with explicit entropy/monopoly retention and a text-field official-like micro+macro gate; do not use raw JSONL wrapper loss or four single-window eval loss as the promotion gate.

resolved_testing_gaps.final_block_oracle_rate: RESOLVED; regret0p01 improves final-block selected-is-oracle rate and final-block regret.
resolved_testing_gaps.full_network_oracle: RESOLVED; greedy full-network oracle still shows large headroom and regret0p01 does not reduce full-network regret versus no-regret baseline.
resolved_testing_gaps.lm_eval_reason: RESOLVED; old four-window LM gate was under-sampled, but broader content-aware gates still do not support robust promotion.
resolved_testing_gaps.official_like_text_content: RESOLVED_MIXED; small micro improvement, only 3/7 file wins, math regression.
resolved_testing_gaps.raw_json_wrapper_bias: RESOLVED; regret0p01 strongly helps first JSONL metadata blocks but fails after content begins.
resolved_testing_gaps.report_or_checkpoint_inconsistency: RESOLVED_NOT_CAUSAL; exact checkpoints, no resume events, matched tokens/windows.

router_lm_mismatch.recommendation: Do not promote regret0p01. Replace the four-window LM gate with a full official-like micro/macro gate, then test lower or annealed regret weights with an entropy/monopoly retention constraint.

router_regret.diagnosis: Router regret is material in diagnostic audits. Expert-bank capacity exists under oracle-style interventions, so router repair should precede scaling. Because the full-network audit is greedy and development-only, this does not prove a deployable oracle model or an official benchmark advantage.
router_regret.scope: Consolidates existing final-block frozen-official and greedy full-network official-like development audits. No training and no final official-file tuning.

scale_recommendation: Do not scale current teacher-independent sparse-v2. Run router-regret repair on official-like dev first, then a clean 250K/500K/1M rung sequence.
